instrument: Meade StarNavigator NG 102 (660 mm f/6.5), motor boards driven by firmware/mount_controller on an Arduino Uno

az.method: ~148,000-count out-and-back moves read against the azimuth setting circle (48 deg, +-1 deg reading), two repeats; scripts/hbx_large_move.py
az.note: Refine with a sky fit (absorb_scale). See hardware_findings.md 'counts per degree from large moves'.

alt.method: ~148,000-count out-and-back move read against the side angle scale (35 deg, +-1 deg reading); scripts/hbx_large_move.py
alt.note: Phone-inclinometer or accelerometer reading would tighten this.

az.note: Not measured. Seen as 'significant' by eye and as ~1000 extra encoder counts on reversal at full slew (hardware_findings.md). Measure with camera or accelerometer: approach a target from both directions, compare encoder counts.

speed_regulation_accuracy_fraction.method: commanded vs encoder counts/s at 0.5x-32x sidereal, both axes (hardware_findings.md low-speed sweep)
speed_regulation_accuracy_fraction.note: Upper bound: at the 100 ms position-sampling resolution.

max_counts_per_s.note: Raised from 1300 to reach the handbox speed 8 (1.5 deg/s) on both axes. Regulated speeds tested up to ~1235 counts/s on 2026-11-24; higher speeds: hardware_findings.md 2026-11-26.

az_travel_limit_deg.method: user rule: cables attached to the telescope
az_travel_limit_deg.note: +- this many degrees from the session start; revisit when cabling is final.

CA.note: Collimation. Fit from a >=6-star session, then store here.

NPAE.note: Axis non-perpendicularity. Fit from a >=6-star session.

TF.note: Tube flex. Needs stars over a wide altitude range.

SA.note: Keep 0: fitted scale goes into mount.counts_per_degree via absorb_scale.

SE.note: Keep 0: fitted scale goes into mount.counts_per_degree via absorb_scale.

narrow.description: User's Pi Zero W + Pi Camera v1 (OV5647, 2592x1944, 1.4 um px) for the NG 102 focuser

scale_arcsec_px.note: Expected 0.4375 at prime focus (1.4 um / 660 mm), FOV 0.315 x 0.236 deg; not measured. Measure: two frames with a known small mount move (counts) between them.

roll_deg.note: From the same two-frame calibration (direction of motion in the image).

flip_x.note: 1 if the image is mirrored (e.g. star diagonal); from an az move vs image direction.

width_px.method: sensor spec, confirmed by rpicam-hello --list-cameras on the Pi
width_px.note: Full-sensor pixels: the camera server reports star positions in these units in every sensor mode.

height_px.method: sensor spec, confirmed by rpicam-hello --list-cameras on the Pi
height_px.note: Full-sensor pixels: the camera server reports star positions in these units in every sensor mode.

boresight_x_px.note: Pixel defined as 'where the mount points'; default image centre.

imu.note: Placeholder: Pololu MinIMU-9 v3 (LSM303D + L3GD20H) planned on the tube in a PLA housing. Store accelerometer zero offsets/scales and magnetometer hard/soft-iron calibration here once mounted.
